prompt:
Create a static tool called Liberty Argument Arsenal for The Radical Libertarian.
Visual style: tactical political briefing room, black/red/cream, brutalist cards, stamped labels, bold headings.
Strong hook: “Bring Better Arguments to the Permission-Slip Apocalypse.”
Target visitor psychology: contrarians, libertarians, creators, podcasters, newsletter writers, debate goblins with principles.
Hero message: “Pick an issue and get a clean liberty-based argument, common objections, counterpoints, and social-ready one-liners.”
CTA: “Load the Arsenal”
Sections needed:
- Hero
- Issue selector
- Argument card
- Counterargument card
- One-liner generator
- Copy button
- Related episode/article section
- Newsletter CTA
Use JavaScript for issue selection and copy-to-clipboard.
